sections.title: The letter dzé
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (dzé) /dzeː/. Its main sound appears in (dzsungel) /ˈd͡ʒuŋɡɛl/, which means jungle. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, place your tongue tip against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Stop the air, then release it into a gentle buzz. Touch your throat to feel your vocal cords vibrate. For the second sound, pull your tongue slightly further back. Round your lips a little, release the air, and keep your voice on.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In ordinary words and loanwords, this letter makes its first sound, as in (bodza) /ˈbod͡zɒ/. That sound also lengthens between vowels, as in (edző) /ˈɛd͡zːøː/. When the letter s stands right after it, the combination sounds like (dzseki) /ˈd͡ʒɛki/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not split the sound into two separate parts like d followed by z. Blend them smoothly into one unit, like the ends of beds or birds. For the second sound, avoid whispering. Keep your vocal cords vibrating so it sounds voiced, like the j in jungle.
